text: A monad on a category C is a triple (T, η, μ) where η: Id ⇒ T is the unit, μ: T² ⇒ T is the multiplication, satisfying:
choices: monad laws: μ∘Tη = id = μ∘ηT and μ∘Tμ = μ∘μT
T is a functor preserving limits
explanation: Monad axioms: unit laws (μ∘Tη=μ∘ηT=id_T) and associativity (μ∘Tμ=μ∘μT). Monads generalise monoids from Set to functor categories.
